response: The observation of cerebromediastinal tuberculosis in a child with a probable Say-Barber-Miller syndrome is exceptional due to the very early age of onset of extrapulmonary tuberculosis, the absence of an immune deficit, and the association with a rare congenital neurological syndrome. While the exact relationship between the two conditions is not fully understood, it is possible that there may be a link between them. Further discussion and investigation are needed to explore the potential causative link between cerebromediastinal tuberculosis and Say-Barber-Miller syndrome.
